in_arabic.name: الواعقيت
in_arabic.long_meaning: الواعقيت هو اسم مشتق من الواقعة التي تعني الحادثة أو الوقت، ويستخدم لوصف الشخص الذي يدرك أهمية الوقت والزمن في الحياة، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام حيث يُشجع المسلمون على تقدير الوقت والزمن في عملهم وعباداتهم

in_urdu.name: الواعقيت
in_urdu.long_meaning: الواعقیت نام کا مطلب ہے وقت اور زمانہ، اور یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو وقت اور زمانے کی اہمیت کو سمجھتا ہے، اور اسلام میں اس کا بہت زیادہ महत्व ہے کیونکہ مسلموں کو وقت اور زمانے کی قدر کرنے کی ترغیب دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: अलवाकीत
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलवाकीत नाम का अर्थ है समय और काल, और यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो समय और काल की महत्ता को समझता है, और इस्लाम में इसका बहुत बड़ा महत्व है क्योंकि मुसलमानों को समय और काल की कद्र करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: الواعقيت
in_pashto.long_meaning: الواعقيت نوم خلاصه ده چې وخت او زمان دی، او دا نوم هغه کس لپاره کارېږي چې وخت او زمان پوهیږي، او په اسلام کې دا نوم ډېر важنی دی ځکه چې مسلمانانو ته وخت او زمان درځ کولو ته هڅوي

in_english.name: Alwaaqit
in_english.long_meaning: Alwaaqit name means time and era, and it is used for the person who understands the importance of time and era, and it has great significance in Islam because Muslims are encouraged to appreciate time and era in their work and worship

data.cultural_impact: The name Alwaaqit holds a significant cultural importance in Islam as it reflects the virtues of patience and wisdom, which are considered essential qualities for a believer to possess. Alwaaqit reminds Muslims of the importance of perseverance, even in the most difficult of situations. It is a reminder to stay calm and composed, and to avoid impulsive action that may lead to unnecessary hardships.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Alwaaqit has profound significance for Muslims. It alludes to the divine attribute of God, who is described in the Quran as being patient (Al-Sabur) and wise (Al-Hakim). Alwaaqit is a reminder to emulate these attributes and strive to be more like Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Alwaaqit in Arabic translates to "The Reckoners" or "The Accountants". This name signifies the idea of being held accountable for every deed in this life, emphasizing the importance of good actions and the Day of Judgment.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic term 'Alwaaqit' (Arabic: الواقت), which refers to specific time periods in Islamic prayer rituals, has gained modern relevance in the context of time management, productivity apps, and digital calendars. Alwaaqit has become a popular search term on iOS, Android, and web platforms, as Muslim users seek to integrate their religious practices with their daily schedules and productivity goals. This trend is driven by the increasing availability of technology designed to cater to the needs of Muslims, including apps that provide prayer times, Quran reading tools, and calendar features tailored to Islamic holidays and traditions. The use of Alwaaqit on modern platforms not only facilitates religious observance but also helps users to manage their time effectively and stay organized, making it a valuable tool for both spiritual and practical purposes.
